What the homeowner is dealing with

Indoor fan runs and air moves from the vents, but the air is not cold. Started Tuesday, gradually rather than suddenly. Thermostat is calling for cool at 70°F with the room sitting at 78°F. The outdoor unit is running and the fan is turning. No ice visible on the accessible line. Filter was replaced 3 weeks ago and photographs as clean.

The seven facts worth reading first

  • Outdoor fan is turning, unit is audibly running seen in video
  • Thermostat: cool, set 70°F, room 78°F seen in photo
  • Air from vents is moving at normal strength reported
  • No visible ice on accessible refrigerant line confirmed
  • Filter clean, replaced ~3 weeks ago seen in photo
  • Onset gradual over ~2 days, not sudden reported
  • No breaker trips, no burning smell, no water confirmed

Where the evidence points
Low refrigerant charge / leakMost consistent

For — gradual onset over days, unit running normally, airflow normal, no ice at the accessible section.

Against — no oil staining reported at the accessible line-set.

Failing capacitor / compressor not stagingPossible

For — fan turning does not confirm the compressor is doing work.

Against — homeowner reports compressor audible, though untrained assessment.

Airflow restriction downstream of the filterLess likely

For — cannot be excluded without inspecting the coil.

Against — filter clean and vent airflow reported normal.

inference  These are reasoning from the evidence above, offered to save discovery time. They are not a diagnosis and the technician's own tests decide.
